label: Contingent thinking members of a selected actual cone are grounded
term: contingent-thinker-only grounding in an actual cone
definition: ConeContingentThinkersGrounded m w Occurs Bears b requires an actual concrete ground only for members x of the complete actual concrete cone of b which bear an occurring thought and are contingent at w. It does not ground contingent nonthinkers, guarantee thinkerhood of their predecessors, or supply a ground of necessary thinking members.
note: Explicit weakening of DEF-SELECTED-CONE-CONTINGENT-GROUNDED and the earlier thinker ancestry assumption. An intended two-world control for #1791 (not yet supplied as a checked finite model) would have a nonthinking contingent q as an ungrounded cone member while a contingent thinker b has a ground and an actual necessary thinking root n, showing that this narrower scope can hold where the all-cone anti-brute condition fails; until that model is checked this strictness is unverified. NecessaryAt is accessibility-relative and de re (DEF-KANT-MODAL-NECESSITY). Applicability is open.
